hero.title: Your own store on Qlozet, ready when you are.
hero.description: Every vendor gets a store page shoppers can browse, follow and buy from: your cover photo, your logo, your colours and all your pieces. No website to build.

profile.title: Set it up from your console
profile.description: Store profile is where your store page comes together. Add a cover photo and logo, pick your store colour, and tell shoppers who you are. A progress bar shows what's left.
points: Cover photo, logo and store colour
About the store, contact and social links
View storefront to see it as shoppers do

address.title: One link for your bio, WhatsApp and cards
address.description: Pick a name and your store lives at shop.qlozet.app/s/your-name. Shared anywhere, it shows a preview with your cover, logo, location and how many pieces you have.
points: Copy or share in one tap
Change it later and old links still work

reviews.title: Let your buyers do the talking
reviews.description: Ratings from people who bought your pieces add up to your store's score, shown at the top of your page. Shoppers can read every review before they order.
points: Your average rating on your store page
Only people who bought and received it can review

closing.title: Your Store. Your Brand. Your Future.
closing.description: Qlozet gives you a store page, payments and delivery from day one. Start building your brand today.
